summary: Correct the existing Pine Gate Renewables production and seed record in place from Active to Realized as of the 2026-04-22 plan effective date, close directly evidenced prepetition infrastructure-owner periods on that date, and record the split bankruptcy sales without treating any purchaser as the successor to the integrated Pine Gate platform. Fresh court filings resolve the prior realization and purchaser uncertainty. They do not establish a single replacement source task, HESTA's direct legal ownership, or complete ownership and stake schedules for MorningSky, ACT, Brookfield, Nofar, or Oregon Solar.
resolvedFormerBlockers: Docket 2030 directly verifies the 2026-04-22 plan effective date and all five sale purchasers, orders, and closing dates.
Docket 1460 directly verifies cancellation of all existing equity on the effective date and shows that the Plan Administrator's Single Unit is custodial rather than operating-platform equity.
Docket 19 directly verifies the prepetition PGR/PGR Holdco boundary, Generate affiliate vehicles, HOOPP, the common-owner chain, and management incentive units.
Docket 1125 and the direct Fundamental release distinguish the MorningSky development successor from excluded assets and from the original integrated Pine Gate platform.
The direct ACT release verifies a separate O&M successor acquired in the bankruptcy sale, while the court monthly operating report records its sale closing on 2026-01-30.
No source task in the execution manifest replaces Pine Gate Renewables; Task 157 is Advanced Cooling Technologies rather than ACT Power Services.

identityResolution.boundary: Retain Pine Gate Renewables as the historical integrated U.S. solar-and-storage development and owner-operator platform. MorningSky is the separate development successor; ACT is the separate O&M successor; Nofar, Oregon Solar/Amazon, and Brookfield acquired separate project packages; the Plan Administrator and GUC Trust are wind-down actors, not operating-platform owners.

applicationRequirements: Recapture a fresh production company snapshot and fresh source-task and dependency snapshots against the current protected-main baseline before proposal generation.
Correct the existing company in place to Realized with 2026-04-22 as the realization date; do not mark the source task SUPERSEDED because no replacement task exists.

Close the existing Generate ownership period on 2026-04-22 and add or normalize the directly evidenced HOOPP former ownership period only if the fresh production and seed snapshots remain collision-free and the generated after-image preserves vehicle and stake disclosure limits.
Do not add HESTA as a direct owner, do not add the Plan Administrator or GUC Trust as an owner, and do not infer Generate or HOOPP percentages, fund, or undisclosed subscription dates.

Do not create or merge MorningSky, ACT, Brookfield, Nofar, Amazon/Oregon Solar, or project-level records as part of this task without separately sourced, fresh, collision-free proposals and compatible task dependencies.
Add only directly supported bankruptcy-sale, plan-effective, and realization milestones and citations through the protected PortCo batch workflow.
Use exactly one application primary citation bound to the court-filed docket 2030 PDF; retain docket 1460 and other verified sources as supporting lineage.
